concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-online-payments-transaction-fees]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured online/POS platform fee split hierarchy, liable-account default and transfer/report reconciliation; worked examples contain account-destination and currency contradictions.
warnings: The source's AdyenFees example conflicts on user versus platform liable balance destination (raw lines 1141 versus 99–104, 1147 and 1301), and its EUR 80 prose conflicts with USD 80 payment/authorization code and EUR webhook examples; verify actual request and account route.

Processing costs, 3DS enrollment aggregates and tiered discounts cannot be passed as individual payment fee splits. More granular fee types override aggregates; omitted fee splits default to liable balance.
Authorization and transfer received/authorised states are not captured/booked fees or bank receipt. The page does not settle partial-refund or chargeback fee reversal allocation.
